beats.label: S1 · June becomes Offred
beats.text: Torn from Luke and Hannah at the border, June is indoctrinated by Aunt Lydia at the Red Center and becomes Offred, handmaid to Commander Fred Waterford.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the world, June's captivity, and the drive to find Hannah that fuels everything after.

beats.label: S1 · Mayday and Emily's fate
beats.text: Her shopping partner Ofglen reveals the Mayday resistance; when Emily is caught in a same-sex relationship, Gilead mutilates her and takes her away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the resistance June will later join and shows the price of dissent — Emily becomes a load-bearing figure across future seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Fred's protocol breaks
beats.text: Fred breaks protocol with private Scrabble games and a trip to the Jezebels brothel; Serena separately sends June to sleep with Nick, suspecting Fred is sterile.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Waterfords' fault lines, Moira's rediscovery, and the Nick affair that produces June's baby.

beats.label: S1 · The pregnancy
beats.text: June becomes pregnant. Serena knows Fred cannot be the father, drives her past Hannah as a threat, and warns her the baby's safety depends on obedience.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pregnancy makes June both valuable and hunted — the engine of S2 and the wedge between Fred and Serena.

beats.label: S1 · Moira reaches Canada
beats.text: Moira escapes Jezebels and crosses into Canada, where Luke — who survived the border ambush — is granted asylum in Toronto's Little America.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the Canadian front of the story and the long-distance parallel to June's captivity.

beats.label: S1 · Stones dropped, black van
beats.text: Ordered to stone Janine, the handmaids collectively drop their stones — their first open defiance. A black van comes for June; Nick tells her to trust it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The stoning refusal is the first collective act of rebellion; the van's uncertain intent is the season's central cliffhanger.

cliffhanger.text: A pregnant June is loaded into a black van at Nick's urging, its purpose — Mayday rescue or Eye punishment — unknown. Serena's threats hang over Hannah, and Rita is now sitting on a hidden bundle of Jezebels letters that document Gilead's atrocities.
questions: Is the van coming for June a Mayday rescue or the Eyes taking her away?
Will Serena carry through her threats against Hannah?
What happens when the smuggled letters from Jezebels reach the outside world?

characters.name: June Osborne (Offred)
characters.line: Handmaid to Commander Waterford, secretly pregnant by Nick, and being driven off in a black van whose intent she cannot know.

characters.name: Commander Fred Waterford
characters.line: Powerful architect of Gilead, likely sterile; broke his own rules with June through private Scrabble games and a night at the Jezebels brothel.

characters.name: Serena Joy Waterford
characters.line: Fred's wife and Gilead's co-founder, now bitter and childless; engineered June's affair with Nick and threatens Hannah over the pregnancy.

characters.name: Nick Blaine
characters.line: The Waterfords' driver and a secret Eye; father of June's baby, quietly telling her to trust the van as it drives her off.

characters.name: Aunt Lydia
characters.line: Trainer of handmaids at the Red Center, both brutal and tender; ordered the stoning of Janine that the handmaids refused.

characters.name: Moira
characters.line: June's best friend from before Gilead; escaped Jezebels and reached Canada, reunited with Luke.

characters.name: Luke Bankole
characters.line: June's husband; survived the border ambush and lives in Toronto's Little America, now holding a letter from her.

characters.name: Emily / Ofglen
characters.line: Handmaid who first told June about Mayday; caught in her marriage, genitally mutilated and taken away in a van.

characters.name: Janine / Ofwarren
characters.line: Fragile handmaid who bore Angela and handed her to June on a bridge before jumping alone into the icy water; comatose then spared when the handmaids refused to stone her.

beats.label: S2 · Boston Globe and recapture
beats.text: Nick smuggles June to a safehouse in the abandoned Boston Globe offices; she is caught trying to fly out and returned to the Waterfords, now openly defiant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the underground network that will later carry her out, and hardens June for the confrontations that follow.

beats.label: S2 · Nick married off
beats.text: Serena confirms June's pregnancy and softens toward her, but Fred marries the driver Nick off to 15-year-old Eden to break his hold on June.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Complicates the Nick/June affair and puts Eden in the household — the pressure that leads to her execution.

beats.label: S2 · The Rachel and Leah bombing
beats.text: Emily is sent to the Colonies to die and returns as a handmaid after a former handmaid bombs the new Rachel and Leah Center, killing dozens of Commanders.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mass casualties shake Gilead's hierarchy and pull Emily back into June's orbit for the escape at season's end.

beats.label: S2 · Serena rises and is broken
beats.text: Serena signs Fred's orders in his hospital absence and later proposes girls learn to read Scripture; Fred beats her, and Gilead cuts off her finger.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The finger and the beating are the moment Serena stops believing in the regime she built, which triggers her final act.

beats.label: S2 · Eden and Isaac drowned
beats.text: Nick's child bride Eden runs off with Guardian Isaac; both are drowned for infidelity after refusing to repent, hardening those who watch.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Eden's execution is the visible cruelty that pushes Serena toward helping June and completes Nick's isolation.

beats.label: S2 · Holly born, Holly sent, June stays
beats.text: June gives birth alone at a remote house. Serena helps her flee, but June puts baby Nichole on the escape truck with Emily and stays behind to find Hannah.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The choice that defines June going forward — refusing safety for her daughter's sake — and the reason S3 opens with her still in Gilead.

cliffhanger.text: Emily is driving baby Nichole toward the Canadian border while June walks back into Gilead. Serena has crossed a line she cannot uncross by letting them go, and Nick has been left behind with nothing.
questions: Can June actually reach Hannah from inside Gilead?
Will Serena's help be discovered by Fred?
What happens to Emily and the baby before they reach the border?

characters.name: June Osborne
characters.line: Gave birth to Nichole then refused to flee with her; walking back into Gilead determined to find Hannah.

characters.name: Serena Joy Waterford
characters.line: Fractured from Fred, who beat her and let Gilead cut off her finger; helped June flee with the newborn.

characters.name: Commander Fred Waterford
characters.line: Increasingly cruel — raped June under the guise of inducing labour and beat Serena when she overstepped.

characters.name: Nick Blaine
characters.line: Newly widowed after Eden's execution; still loves June and helped move her toward the escape.

characters.name: Emily
characters.line: Survived the Colonies and saw her new Commander die during a Ceremony; handed the wheel of an escape truck with baby Nichole in tow.

characters.name: Aunt Lydia
characters.line: Still enforcing the regime but showing new fissures; stabbed by Emily before Emily's departure.

characters.name: Commander Joseph Lawrence
characters.line: Erratic architect of the Colonies who took Emily as handmaid — then quietly loaded her into the escape truck.

characters.name: Eleanor Lawrence
characters.line: Lawrence's mentally unstable wife, openly hostile to Gilead's rituals.

characters.name: Luke Bankole
characters.line: In Toronto with Moira, now waiting on the truck carrying his wife's baby by another man.

beats.label: S3 · Reassigned to Lawrence
beats.text: Emily reaches Canada with baby Nichole, who is placed with Luke and Moira; June is reassigned to Commander Joseph Lawrence, the architect of the Colonies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Nichole safe in Canada and puts June in the one household where a resistance plot is possible.

beats.label: S3 · Mayday inside the household
beats.text: At the Lawrence house June joins a Mayday cell of Marthas including Beth; she reunites with Nick, now a Commander bound for the Chicago front.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Builds the network that will attempt the plane rescue and re-establishes Nick as a Commander with reach.

beats.label: S3 · DC and Serena's defection
beats.text: In Washington the Waterfords see handmaids fully muzzled shut; Mark Tuello fails to turn Serena but slips a satellite phone into her purse so she can reach him later.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The muzzles show Gilead's next stage, and Tuello's phone is the mechanism that puts Fred in Canadian custody.

beats.label: S3 · Waterfords in custody
beats.text: Serena tricks Fred across the border, where Canadian authorities arrest him for war crimes — but Fred exposes her guilt in Nichole's kidnapping and she is detained too.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the Waterfords from Gilead and puts them in the ICC's reach, setting up S4's trial storyline.

beats.label: S3 · Eleanor let to die
beats.text: Lawrence's unstable wife Eleanor overdoses on medication after nearly exposing the escape plot; June finds her, quietly leaves her, and lets her die.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The most explicit sign yet of June's willingness to sacrifice others for the cause — the moral line she has crossed by S4.

beats.label: S3 · Winslow and the plane
beats.text: June kills High Commander Winslow at Jezebels and leads children onto a plane out of Gilead. She is shot covering their escape but is carried away by handmaids alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The centrepiece of the season and the reason June is a wanted fugitive at the start of S4.

cliffhanger.text: Children including baby Nichole are on Canadian soil. Both Waterfords sit in Canadian detention, each having betrayed the other. June is bleeding out in the woods, carried away by her handmaids.
questions: Will the Waterfords face trial for war crimes?
How does Gilead retaliate for the mass exodus of its children?

characters.name: June Osborne
characters.line: Handmaid to Commander Lawrence, wounded but alive after leading children out of Gilead on a plane.

characters.name: Nick Blaine
characters.line: Now a Commander bound for the Chicago front, still risking himself for June.

characters.name: Commander Fred Waterford
characters.line: In Canadian custody after Serena tricked him across the border; awaiting war crimes charges.

characters.name: Serena Joy Waterford
characters.line: In Canadian custody beside Fred after he exposed her role in Nichole's kidnapping.

characters.name: Commander Joseph Lawrence
characters.line: Sheltered June and the child-smuggling operation; a widower now that Eleanor is dead.

characters.name: Aunt Lydia
characters.line: Threatened at gunpoint by a handmaid mid-season; still central to handmaid discipline.

characters.name: Mark Tuello
characters.line: US operative who orchestrated Fred's arrest and works with Gilead defectors.

characters.name: Luke Bankole
characters.line: Raising baby Nichole with Moira in Toronto and receiving new refugees from the plane rescue.

characters.name: Moira
characters.line: In Canada with Luke, raising Nichole and supporting the exodus.

characters.name: Rita
characters.line: Escaped Gilead as the carer of the rescued children, now free in Canada.

beats.label: S4 · Keyes farm and Jezebels
beats.text: Handmaids hide the wounded June at 14-year-old Esther Keyes's farm; the group poisons a room of Commanders at Jezebels before Nick tracks them down.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Esther, shows June turning openly militant, and sets up the manhunt that ends the season's first act.

beats.label: S4 · The train tracks
beats.text: Under torture and threats to Hannah, June gives up the handmaids' location; Alma, Brianna, Beth and Sienna die in the fallout as she and Janine escape.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moral cost that reshapes June: her closest allies are dead by her word, and only Janine remains at her side.

beats.label: S4 · Chicago bombed
beats.text: June joins the American rebels in Chicago; Gilead bombs the city just before a promised ceasefire and Moira finds a shell-shocked June in the rubble.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The bridge that finally moves June out of Gilead and into Moira's rescue boat to Canada.

beats.label: S4 · Testimony in Canada
beats.text: Reunited with Luke, Nichole and Rita in Canada, June testifies against the Waterfords at the ICC — but Fred begins bargaining Gilead's secrets for freedom.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fred's plea deal is the setup for the murder plot that closes the season.

beats.label: S4 · Nick's file on Hannah
beats.text: Serena is revealed to be pregnant with Fred's son; Nick, still working with Lawrence inside Gilead, meets June in the neutral zone and hands her a file on Hannah.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Refixes June's target on Hannah for S5 and keeps Nick as her one Gilead-side lifeline.

beats.label: S4 · Fred killed in No Man's Land
beats.text: To stop Fred's deal, June has him traded for 22 prisoners and dropped in No Man's Land, where she and the ex-handmaids beat him to death and mail Serena his finger.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The murder redefines June for Luke and for herself, and Serena receives the finger that opens S5.

cliffhanger.text: Fred is dead in the woods; his ring finger is in Serena's mail. June arrived home covered in blood and Luke has seen for the first time what she is now willing to do. Hannah is somewhere in Gilead.
questions: Can Luke live with what June has become?
How will Serena react to Fred's murder while carrying his son alone in prison?
Will June ever be able to reach Hannah?

characters.name: June Osborne
characters.line: Escaped Gilead to Canada then led a mob of ex-handmaids in murdering Fred; spiralling into vengeance.

characters.name: Luke Bankole
characters.line: Reunited with June but disturbed by her violence, especially after her role in Fred's killing.

characters.name: Moira
characters.line: Works with a relief NGO in Canada; found June in the Chicago rubble and pulled her out.

characters.name: Serena Joy Waterford
characters.line: Pregnant with Fred's son and in Canadian custody; Fred is dead and his severed finger is now in her hands.

characters.name: Nick Blaine
characters.line: Still in Gilead as a Commander working with Lawrence; delivered a file on Hannah to June in the neutral zone.

characters.name: Commander Joseph Lawrence
characters.line: Reinstated as a High Commander in Gilead after brokering deals with Aunt Lydia.

characters.name: Aunt Lydia
characters.line: Reinstated as an active Aunt, given Janine to mentor again after weathering her interrogation.

characters.name: Mark Tuello
characters.line: American liaison who handled June's rescue and quietly arranged Fred's fatal prisoner swap.

characters.name: Janine
characters.line: Escapes with June at the train tracks and reaches Chicago, but is recaptured later and placed back in Aunt Lydia's care as a handmaid in training.

characters.name: Esther Keyes
characters.line: Fourteen-year-old bride of a Commander who sheltered wounded June and helped kill her rapist.

beats.label: S5 · Fred's funeral and Hannah on jumbotrons
beats.text: Serena returns to Gilead, buries Fred as a hero and has Hannah presented at the televised funeral — a message aimed straight at June in Toronto.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Serena's new weapon (Hannah as leverage) and the antagonism that drives the season.

beats.label: S5 · Nick weds Rose; New Bethlehem
beats.text: Nick, now married to Rose, drifts back into service; Lawrence pitches New Bethlehem, an enclave meant to lure Gileadean exiles home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Places Nick inside the Wharton dynasty and puts New Bethlehem on the table — both central to S6.

beats.label: S5 · Putnam executed
beats.text: After Esther becomes pregnant by rape, Nick and Lawrence have Commander Putnam arrested and Nick executes him; Aunt Lydia begins to soften.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Nick and Lawrence acting against fellow Commanders and marks the start of Lydia's turn.

beats.label: S5 · No Man's Land and Noah's birth
beats.text: June and Luke enter No Man's Land seeking Hannah's school and are captured; Serena shoots her captor to escape with them and gives birth to a son, Noah.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Forces June and Serena together as reluctant partners and delivers Noah, the child around whom S6 turns.

beats.label: S5 · The Wheelers; Nick turns mole
beats.text: June hands Serena to Canadian border police; the Wheelers use Serena as foster mother to Noah, and Nick agrees to spy for the Americans to protect June.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Places Serena inside the Wheelers' cage and turns Nick into an active US asset.

beats.label: S5 · Hit-and-run, arrests, the train
beats.text: A Gilead sympathiser runs June down; Luke beats the driver to death and lets police take him so June can flee with Nichole. On the Vancouver train she finds Serena, fleeing with Noah.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Luke from the board, exiles June again and puts her and Serena on the same train — the S6 opener.

cliffhanger.text: June and Serena, each with an infant and each a fugitive, ride the same Vancouver-bound train, no longer certain who is hunting them and who is helping. Luke is in Canadian police custody; Nick is playing both sides.
questions: Can June and Serena share this escape without turning on each other?
Will Luke get free of Canadian custody?
How long can Nick play both sides before he is exposed?

characters.name: June Osborne
characters.line: Killed Fred and cannot escape the guilt; on a Vancouver-bound train with Nichole after Luke's arrest.

characters.name: Serena Joy Waterford
characters.line: Widowed, mother to newborn son Noah; on the same train after escaping the Wheelers' custody.

characters.name: Luke Bankole
characters.line: Beat a Gilead sympathiser to death and let Canadian police arrest him so June could flee.

characters.name: Nick Blaine
characters.line: Now married to Rose and an active American mole; loves June, plays two sides.

characters.name: Rose Wharton
characters.line: Nick's wife, pregnant; knows Nick still loves June.

characters.name: Commander Wharton
characters.line: Powerful traditionalist commander wary of Lawrence's liberal experiment; executed by Nick after raping Esther.

characters.name: Commander Joseph Lawrence
characters.line: Married Naomi Putnam and launched New Bethlehem as a softer face of Gilead.

characters.name: Aunt Lydia
characters.line: Increasingly haunted by the regime's cruelty; visibly softening toward the surviving handmaids.

characters.name: Janine
characters.line: Poisoned by Esther and comatose then recovered; still under Aunt Lydia's care.

characters.name: Mark Tuello
characters.line: US contact who runs Nick's information and shelters Gilead defectors in Toronto.

beats.label: S6 · Alaska and Holly
beats.text: June reaches an Alaskan settlement and finds her mother Holly alive; Serena, sheltered at a Christian women's community, is talked into returning to Gilead to reform it from within.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites June with a mother she thought dead and sends Serena back inside — the two poles of the finale.

beats.label: S6 · Rescue in No Man's Land
beats.text: In No Man's Land Nick helps June rescue Luke and Moira from a botched Mayday raid, and the two part promising to see each other again.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up June's alliance with Nick for the endgame and returns Luke and Moira to the fight.

beats.label: S6 · Wharton courts Serena; Lawrence plots
beats.text: Serena is welcomed to New Bethlehem and courted by Commander Wharton; Lawrence, now High Commander, plots to purge the anti-progressive Commanders who want to undo him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Serena at the centre of Gilead again and lines up Lawrence against Bell and the traditionalists.

beats.label: S6 · The wedding cake uprising
beats.text: During Serena and Wharton's wedding Rita drugs the cake; that night handmaids across Boston kill their Commanders and June kills the sadistic Commander Bell.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The uprising that ends the Commanders' hold on Boston and triggers everything that follows.

beats.label: S6 · Execution and liberation
beats.text: June, Aunt Lydia and the uprising's leaders are captured for public execution, but June's speech from the scaffold turns the crowd as American troops storm Boston.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment Gilead's grip on Boston breaks — and Aunt Lydia's public turn against the regime.

beats.label: S6 · Lawrence sacrifices the plane
beats.text: Lawrence boards the escaping High Commanders' plane with a bomb and blows it out of the sky; Rose sends Nick after him for revenge, and June watches him die too.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the ruling Commanders and Nick in a single stroke — the cost of the victory.

beats.label: S6 · Endings
beats.text: Serena is sent to a UN refugee camp with Noah; Janine reunites with Charlotte; June forgives Serena, parts from Luke, and returns to the Waterford house to write her story.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The state of every surviving character as the show closes — and the frame for the book that becomes the tale.

cliffhanger.text: Boston is liberated but Gilead is not gone. Hannah is still on the other side of the wall. June sits in her old room at the Waterford house and begins to record her story as Offred, while Luke fights on with Mayday.
questions: Can what is left of Gilead be fully dismantled?
Will June and Luke find their way back to each other after the war?

characters.name: June Osborne
characters.line: Chose to keep fighting Gilead alongside Tuello; reunited with her mother Holly and finally forgave Serena.

characters.name: Serena Joy Waterford
characters.line: Fled to a UN refugee camp with Noah; forgiven by June and free of Gilead's marriage to Wharton.

characters.name: Luke Bankole
characters.line: Stayed on with Mayday; parted from June with a promise to meet again after the war.

characters.name: Moira
characters.line: Rescued from No Man's Land and back with the resistance.

characters.name: Nick Blaine
characters.line: Boarded the escaping Commanders' plane at Rose's urging and died with them when Lawrence's bomb detonated.

characters.name: Commander Joseph Lawrence
characters.line: Planted the bomb on the High Commanders' plane and sacrificed himself to end the ruling class.

characters.name: Aunt Lydia
characters.line: Turned against Gilead during the uprising; released and helped return Charlotte to Janine at the border.

characters.name: Janine
characters.line: Freed at the new border and reunited with her daughter Charlotte at last.

characters.name: Mark Tuello
characters.line: Revealed as a US military Commander; still working with June against what remains of Gilead.
